_comment: The bundled Clearly MCP connector. Install the plugin → the server + the skills, one step. OAuth, no token: /mcp -> clearly -> Authenticate. (Claude Code namespaces plugin-bundled servers, so /mcp lists it as `plugin:clearly:clearly` — the server name is `clearly`.)
_staging: ⚠ THE STAGING SERVER IS DELIBERATELY NOT BUNDLED (2026-09-10). It was, and this plugin is published to a PUBLIC directory — so every installer received a second connector pointing at our staging worker: an internal hostname disclosed to strangers, and a server nobody outside the team should ever authenticate against. Two servers also make `/mcp` ambiguous for someone whose only question is 'connect my workspace'. To test against staging, add it to your own .mcp.json locally; do not put it back here.
